verdict.rationale: Phaser is a code-first JS/TS library installed via `npm install phaser`, with no editor required (projects can be moved to VS Code). Its CLI downloads and configures official project templates, so a project can be set up and worked on from the terminal. However, that CLI is described as interactive, and no evidence documents a non-interactive build or export command, a headless CI pipeline, or packaging for native targets, which relies on 3rd-party tools. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive build/export command, CI or headless pipeline guidance, first-party native/desktop export, and hands-on corroboration of CI builds.
